notes.title: Free-to-play Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear Community,

After long discussions and analize we as gamedev - LOF Studios decided to change our pricing policy from paid to Free-To-Play in order to reach all segments of Steam users around the world. We hope "Crazy Foods" as being a very fresh (just 1 month old) and astonishing crazy game will reach every Steam user and MOBA lovers and will give happy impressions to all ages of people globally.

Let's make future a better place together!

Enjoy with Crazy Foods! We love you all!

With kindest regards,
LOF Studios gamedev team
